sourceText: I approve creating and implementing a separate scoped prompt-envelope cache fix so B-dc83 can continue.
normalizedOutcome: When an operator runs the lifecycle readiness transition, the command completes predictably and reports the same reviewer evidence verdicts while reading the prompt-envelope ledger once per evidence collection.
acceptanceClaim: B-a2a6 proves that per-collection prompt-envelope caching reduces repeated reads without changing any integrity, freshness, scope, signature, or gate verdict.
